title: Bubble Sort - Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Repeatedly compares adjacent elements and swaps them if out of order; after each full pass, the largest unsorted element bubbles up to its correct position at the end.

title: Bubble Sort in Python - StackAbuse
snippet: An optimization uses a 'swapped' flag to exit early if no swaps occur during a pass, giving best-case O(n) time when the list is already sorted; worst/average case is O(n^2).
